name: An Thuong
summary: The night quarter just inland from My Khe, bounded by Vo Nguyen Giap, Hoang Ke Viem, Chau Thi Vinh Te, and Ngo Thi Si. Walk the lanes of bars and kitchens. Kalà Kalà, on the sand at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, is free to enter. East West faces the water from 08:00 to 01:00, and its page does not print a street. This is not a bar list.
fee: Check on arrival. Kalà Kalà publishes free entry. A drink is not a city ticket.
getThere: Walk west from a My Khe hotel, a few streets inland from the sand. A short Grab from the river.
